title: AI giant Anthropic raising $10B at $350B valuation: Report
summary: Claude maker Anthropic is aiming to nearly double its valuation to $350 billion, with The Wall Street Journal reporting a planned $10 billion raise.

title: Memecoin social buzz grows as traders return to risk assets
summary: Memecoins fell 65% over 2025 as risk-taking behavior dropped among traders, but the tokens are seeing gains as positive sentiment returns to crypto.

title: Solana Mobile to launch SKR token for Seeker phone on Jan. 21
summary: Solana Mobile will airdrop up to 20% of SKR tokens to users of its Seeker phone on Jan. 21, and introduce so-called Guardians to secure the network.

title: 3 ‘checkpoints’ stand between a crypto all-time high in 2026: Bitwise
summary: Bitwise’s Matt Hougan says that post-October liquidation stability, the passage of the CLARITY Act and steady equities must happen before crypto hits new highs.

title: Bitcoin faces ‘boring sideways’ grind in coming months: CryptoQuant CEO
summary: CryptoQuant CEO Ki Young Ju says money flowing into Bitcoin has “dried up” for now, as traders are rotating back to traditional markets.

title: Fireblocks buys crypto accounting platform TRES for $130M
summary: Fireblocks has expanded its institutional offering by buying TRES, a crypto accounting and tax compliance platform, as it looks to keep up with the use of stablecoins.

title: GENIUS Act changes would be a ‘national security trap’: Crypto execs
summary: Pro-crypto lawyer John Deaton argued that banning yield on stablecoins would incentivize the use of China’s interest-bearing digital yuan, hurting the US dollar.

title: Wyoming rolls out state-backed FRNT stablecoin to the public
summary: Wyoming’s Frontier Stable Token (FRNT) is “the first fiat-backed, fully-reserved stable token" to be issued by a US public entity, says state Governor Mark Gordon.

title: Trumps' World Liberty Financial applies for banking charter to expand USD1
summary: The Trump family’s World Liberty Financial filed for a banking charter to gain greater control over its USD1 stablecoin and expand its adoption among institutions.

title: Solana's stablecoin market cap surges by $900M in 24 hours
summary: Stablecoins are emerging as critical infrastructure across both decentralized and traditional financial applications worldwide.
